stop_conditions: Do not start until explicit approval binds this exact plan ID and digest and covers every mutation listed in docs/M14_LOCAL_EXPERIMENT_PLAN_V4.md.
Do not start unless the target application remains at the pinned image digest and exact 90m/140m/109Mi/192Mi two-replica baseline.

Do not start unless cached tag kri-workload:schema12-timeout-20261109 is present on the kind node, the rendered load Job uses imagePullPolicy Never and terminationMessagePolicy File, and every trial Pod resolves to runtime digest import-2026-11-09@sha256:3980b56b915b631157ca6bf8df8ae6c77f503fc77eb7881c25ef402e3325eba8.
Require every succeeded trial to reconcile one schema-1.2 experiment record containing a schema-1.1 completed load summary whose exit code and counts match the sole owned Pod termination evidence.

Do not start until Prometheus is ready, both application targets and cAdvisor are healthy, and every required metric family returns usable series; missing application or client failure evidence makes evaluation inconclusive.

Stop on a failed load Job, stuck worker, contradictory or missing lifecycle evidence, any application Pod not Ready, a new container restart, warning event, node pressure, target or load image drift, configuration drift, co-tenant drift, or unavailable required metric.
plan.rollback_procedure: After candidate trial 2, or immediately after any post-rollout stop condition, use the scoped workload controller with KRI_WORKLOAD_IMAGE=kri-workload:local to re-apply the exact 90m/140m/109Mi/192Mi two-replica baseline; wait for rollout and verify Deployment UID, resources, target image digest, readiness, and no new warning events.
plan.cleanup_procedure: After terminal schema-1.2 records and observations are saved and digested, explicitly stop only the four v4 plan-owned Jobs; retain immutable artifacts, verify all four Jobs are absent, and never delete the application. If candidate configuration was applied, rollback is mandatory before cleanup is declared verified.
